picks.name: Speedy J & Rødhåd present The Department Of Almost
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on WSNWG. Dub techno/techno territory connected to your Hodge and Peverelist picks.
picks.bio: "Second Office" (October 9, 2026, WSNWG) is the debut album from Speedy J and Rødhåd's joint project -- eleven tracks from ten concentrated days in Berlin's WSNWG studio, pairing assertive dub techno grooves with wistful ambient passages.
picks.why_listen: A heavyweight pairing of two techno veterans working at full strength -- driving, dub-inflected tools with real atmosphere, out today.
